notes: 34 new camp upgrades, 66 in all. Highlights: Patron (free first lanterns), Second wind (survive your last life once per run), Morning gift (start with free boons), High roller (better boon odds) and Trophy hand (an extra boon every 5th wave).
New Lore tab: one upgrade per lantern that boosts just that lantern. Each unlocks with its lantern.
Camp upgrade prices now climb faster at higher levels. Levels you already bought stay.
New Boons page on the main menu: see every boon in the game, sorted by rarity, with your odds of drawing each rarity and how many times you have picked each one.
